newsitem.title: JAPAN: JR Tokai says share listing likely in early Oct.
newsitem.headline: JR Tokai says share listing likely in early Oct.

text.p: Central Japan Railway Co said on Friday that its shares are likely to be listed in early October this year.
Central Japan, widely known as JR Tokai, filed preliminary applications on Friday morning with the Tokyo Stock Exchange and exchanges in Osaka and Nagoya, a company spokesman said.
The company will file a similar application with the stock exchange in Kyoto later on Friday, he said.
JR Tokai will make formal applications after its annual shareholders' meeting at the end of June, he said.
"Taking account of procedures JR East and JR West took to list their shares, (JR Tokai) share listing is likely be in early October," the JR Tokai spokesman said.
JR Tokai is part of the formally state-owned Japan Railway (JR) group, in which East Japan Railway Co and West Japan Railway Co have already listed their shares.
